native_mechanisms: Fix the marks' order before any folding — hold silence and lay them in given order, padded/counted, so order and count are locked in (the servant's inflated-house swats).

Race each fixed-size heap through the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist, downhill fold (ninety-degree turn plus corners folded into the centre), and a doubling-back that eats its own trail, repeated so no heap keeps the shape it entered with, with only the running shape carried forward.
Seal the final folded shape to one fixed small size (the owl in the dreamer) and burn every intermediate heap so the token cannot be walked back to its marks.
core_technique: Per-8-byte-block compression of a 64-bit state treated as an 8x8 bit matrix: 10 fixed rounds of XOR-in-message, 90-degree bit-matrix rotation (bswap + bit-transpose, or GFNI affine), carry-propagating corner-fold via 16-bit adds, then Davies-Meyer-style feed-forward addition of the pre-round state — chained Merkle-Damgard-style over length-padded blocks; no multiply-xor-shift accumulator.
